policy: All source dependencies are vendored as git submodules pinned to the exact commits used for the recorded evidence runs. Submodules store only URL + commit in the superproject; large trees, build outputs and venvs are never committed as blobs. scripts/fetch_dependencies.sh reproduces the same checkouts without submodules and applies the one local patch.

dependencies.name: ric-plt-lib-rmr
dependencies.role: RMR message router (C library) - RIC message bus between A1 mediator and xApp
dependencies.build_command: mkdir .build && cd .build && cmake .. -DDEV_PKG=1 -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local && make install && cd .. && mkdir .build-rt && cd .build-rt && cmake .. -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local && make install && ldconfig

dependencies.name: ric-plt-a1
dependencies.role: Near-RT RIC A1 mediator (Go) - A1-P /A1-P/v2 northbound REST, forwards A1_POLICY_REQ over RMR, records enforceStatus in SDL (redis)
dependencies.build_command: go build -o a1mediator ./cmd/a1.go  # Go >= 1.22 (go.mod); go1.24.7 used; librmr must be installed

dependencies.name: ric-app-hw-python
dependencies.role: Official O-RAN-SC reference xApp - real A1 policy consumer over RMR in the xApp E2E proof
dependencies.build_command: python3.11 -m venv venv-xapp && venv-xapp/bin/pip install -e . && venv-xapp/bin/pip install 'protobuf==3.20.3'
dependencies.note: Not a patch: deploy/xapp-e2e/run_stack.sh adds "xapp_name": "hw-python" to init/config-file.json at run time (upstream expects the RIC helm configmap to inject that key) and reformats the JSON in doing so.

dependencies.name: sim-a1-interface
dependencies.role: O-RAN-SC A1 simulator (near-rt-ric-simulator, STD_2.0.0) - OSC A1 conformance smoke target for scripts/osc_a1_live_smoke.py
dependencies.build_command: docker build near-rt-ric-simulator/  # or run near-rt-ric-simulator/src with the deps/locks/a1sim.txt venv
dependencies.note: Local build inserted this sandbox's HTTPS-proxy CA into the Dockerfile and relaxed the python3=3.10.15-r0 apk pin (that alpine package revision is no longer served). Environment-specific build fixes; deliberately not vendored.

dependencies.name: ocudu
dependencies.role: OCUDU O-RAN CU/DU stack (C++17, srsRAN lineage) - RAN-side component for E2 integration; build still in progress when this manifest was written, no OCUDU-derived evidence recorded yet
dependencies.version: dev branch tip 2026-07-24 (origin/HEAD at pin time)

dependencies.name: flexric
dependencies.role: FlexRIC (Mosaic5G/OAI) near-RT RIC + E2 agent - pinned for the E2 leg of the stack; not yet built or exercised in this session
dependencies.license: OAI Collaborative Standards Software License v1.0 (CSSL); per-file SPDX in LICENSES/
dependencies.build_command: mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. && make  # upstream flow; not yet validated here
